514	class BatchMolGraph:
515	    """
516	    A :class:`BatchMolGraph` represents the graph structure and featurization of a batch of molecules.
517	
518	    A BatchMolGraph contains the attributes of a :class:`MolGraph` plus:
519	
520	    * :code:`atom_fdim`: The dimensionality of the atom feature vector.
521	    * :code:`bond_fdim`: The dimensionality of the bond feature vector (technically the combined atom/bond features).
522	    * :code:`a_scope`: A list of tuples indicating the start and end atom indices for each molecule.
523	    * :code:`b_scope`: A list of tuples indicating the start and end bond indices for each molecule.
524	    * :code:`max_num_bonds`: The maximum number of bonds neighboring an atom in this batch.
525	    * :code:`b2b`: (Optional) A mapping from a bond index to incoming bond indices.
526	    * :code:`a2a`: (Optional): A mapping from an atom index to neighboring atom indices.
527	    * :code:`b2br`: (Optional): A mapping from f_bonds to real bonds in molecule recorded in targets.
528	    """
529	
530	    def __init__(self, mol_graphs: List[MolGraph]):
531	        r"""
532	        :param mol_graphs: A list of :class:`MolGraph`\ s from which to construct the :class:`BatchMolGraph`.
533	        """
534	        self.mol_graphs = mol_graphs
535	        self.overwrite_default_atom_features = mol_graphs[0].overwrite_default_atom_features
536	        self.overwrite_default_bond_features = mol_graphs[0].overwrite_default_bond_features
537	        self.is_reaction = mol_graphs[0].is_reaction
538	        self.atom_fdim = get_atom_fdim(overwrite_default_atom=self.overwrite_default_atom_features,
539	                                       is_reaction=self.is_reaction)
540	        self.bond_fdim = get_bond_fdim(overwrite_default_bond=self.overwrite_default_bond_features,
541	                                      overwrite_default_atom=self.overwrite_default_atom_features,
542	                                      is_reaction=self.is_reaction)
543	
544	        # Start n_atoms and n_bonds at 1 b/c zero padding
545	        self.n_atoms = 1  # number of atoms (start at 1 b/c need index 0 as padding)
546	        self.n_bonds = 1  # number of bonds (start at 1 b/c need index 0 as padding)
547	        self.a_scope = []  # list of tuples indicating (start_atom_index, num_atoms) for each molecule
548	        self.b_scope = []  # list of tuples indicating (start_bond_index, num_bonds) for each molecule
549	
550	        # All start with zero padding so that indexing with zero padding returns zeros
551	        f_atoms = [[0] * self.atom_fdim]  # atom features
552	        f_bonds = [[0] * self.bond_fdim]  # combined atom/bond features
553	        a2b = [[]]  # mapping from atom index to incoming bond indices
554	        b2a = [0]  # mapping from bond index to the index of the atom the bond is coming from
555	        b2revb = [0]  # mapping from bond index to the index of the reverse bond
556	        for mol_graph in mol_graphs:
557	            f_atoms.extend(mol_graph.f_atoms)
558	            f_bonds.extend(mol_graph.f_bonds)
559	
560	            for a in range(mol_graph.n_atoms):
561	                a2b.append([b + self.n_bonds for b in mol_graph.a2b[a]])
562	
563	            for b in range(mol_graph.n_bonds):
564	                b2a.append(self.n_atoms + mol_graph.b2a[b])
565	                b2revb.append(self.n_bonds + mol_graph.b2revb[b])
566	
567	            self.a_scope.append((self.n_atoms, mol_graph.n_atoms))
568	            self.b_scope.append((self.n_bonds, mol_graph.n_bonds))
569	            self.n_atoms += mol_graph.n_atoms
570	            self.n_bonds += mol_graph.n_bonds
571	
572	        self.max_num_bonds = max(1, max(
573	            len(in_bonds) for in_bonds in a2b))  # max with 1 to fix a crash in rare case of all single-heavy-atom mols
574	
575	        self.f_atoms = torch.tensor(f_atoms, dtype=torch.float)
576	        self.f_bonds = torch.tensor(f_bonds, dtype=torch.float)
577	        self.a2b = torch.tensor([a2b[a] + [0] * (self.max_num_bonds - len(a2b[a])) for a in range(self.n_atoms)], dtype=torch.long)
578	        self.b2a = torch.tensor(b2a, dtype=torch.long)
579	        self.b2revb = torch.tensor(b2revb, dtype=torch.long)
580	        self.b2b = None  # try to avoid computing b2b b/c O(n_atoms^3)
581	        self.a2a = None  # only needed if using atom messages
582	        self.b2br = None  # only needed in predictions of atomic/bond targets
583	
584	    def get_components(self, atom_messages: bool = False) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor,
585	                                                                   torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor,
586	                                                                   List[Tuple[int, int]], List[Tuple[int, int]]]:
587	        """
588	        Returns the components of the :class:`BatchMolGraph`.
589	
590	        The returned components are, in order:
591	
592	        * :code:`f_atoms`
593	        * :code:`f_bonds`
594	        * :code:`a2b`
595	        * :code:`b2a`
596	        * :code:`b2revb`
597	        * :code:`a_scope`
598	        * :code:`b_scope`
599	
600	        :param atom_messages: Whether to use atom messages instead of bond messages. This changes the bond feature
601	                              vector to contain only bond features rather than both atom and bond features.
602	        :return: A tuple containing PyTorch tensors with the atom features, bond features, graph structure,
603	                 and scope of the atoms and bonds (i.e., the indices of the molecules they belong to).
604	        """
605	        if atom_messages:
606	            f_bonds = self.f_bonds[:, -get_bond_fdim(atom_messages=atom_messages,
607	                                                     overwrite_default_atom=self.overwrite_default_atom_features,
608	                                                     overwrite_default_bond=self.overwrite_default_bond_features):]
609	        else:
610	            f_bonds = self.f_bonds
611	
612	        return self.f_atoms, f_bonds, self.a2b, self.b2a, self.b2revb, self.a_scope, self.b_scope
613	
614	    def get_b2b(self) -> torch.Tensor:
615	        """
616	        Computes (if necessary) and returns a mapping from each bond index to all the incoming bond indices.
617	
618	        :return: A PyTorch tensor containing the mapping from each bond index to all the incoming bond indices.
619	        """
620	        if self.b2b is None:
621	            b2b = self.a2b[self.b2a]  # num_bonds x max_num_bonds
622	            # b2b includes reverse edge for each bond so need to mask out
623	            revmask = (b2b != self.b2revb.unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, b2b.size(1))).long()  # num_bonds x max_num_bonds
624	            self.b2b = b2b * revmask
625	
626	        return self.b2b
